To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
In the presence of sensor failure, the attacker can design a sparse attack vector such that the estimator gives incorrect state estimation and the detector does no raise any alarm.

In the presence of sensor outages, a new class of sparse undetactable attacks can be designed to worsen state estimator's estimation performance even when the bad data detection system does not raise an alarm.

1) a new class of sparse undetected attacks (SUAs), i.e., false data injection attacks, can be designed to worsen estimation performance even in presence of sensor failures, 2) an intelligent SUA strategy is proposed, and 3) numerical results show the effectiveness of the attack design schemes for IEEE 5-, 9-, and 30-bus systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
FDIAs in the presence sensor failures.
the design of SUAs in power systems in the presence of failure.
the design of FDIAs in the presence sensor failures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed attack design strategy can effectively attack the power networks with state estimator and BDD system in the presence and absence of sensor failures.
the proposed attack design strategy can be used to design SUAs in the case of failures and the proposed attack design scheme can be applied in the case without sensor failures.
the proposed attack design strategy is effective in the presence of both random and malicious sensor failures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed SUA design strategy provides a more powerful attack than the existing attacks in the noiseless and noisy cases.
the proposed attack design scheme is able to cause the estimator to provide wrong state estimates even when the detector is able to detect sensor failures.
the proposed attack design strategy can effectively attack the state estimator and BDD system in the presence sensor failures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BDD system can not detect the presence of attacks in the presence of multiple sensor failures.
the existing BDD systems cannot provide effective protection against the SUAs designed in this paper.
the existing attacks are not applicable to networks equipped with BDD system in the presence sensor failures.
